title: An Act to Establish Parity in Funding Between Recovery Community Centers and Peer-run Recovery Centers

summary.text: This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services to maintain funding parity, within a 10% margin, between peer-run recovery centers and recovery community centers. It requires the department to submit an annual report to the joint standing committee of the Legislature having jurisdiction over health and human services matters and requires the department to include in the report an explanation for any variance exceeding the 10% threshold and a plan to achieve compliance with that threshold in the subsequent fiscal year.
